preconditions.description: The number of records in the log is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().split() in [['insert', x], ['getMin', x], ['removeMin']] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each log line is either 'insert x', 'getMin x', or 'removeMin', where x is an integer.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(int(x)) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] in ['insert', 'getMin'])
preconditions.description: All integers in 'insert' and 'getMin' operations are between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, where m is the minimum number of operations needed to make the log consistent, and m is at least the original number of records n.

postconditions.expression: all(line in output_lines for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The original log lines appear in the output in the same order and with the same content.

postconditions.expression: all(heap_min == int(x) for line, heap_min in zip(output_lines, heap_state) if line.split()[0] == 'getMin' and (x := line.split()[1]))
postconditions.description: For every 'getMin x' operation in the output, the minimum element in the heap at that point is exactly x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(heap) > 0 for line, heap in zip(output_lines, heap_state) if line == 'removeMin')
postconditions.description: Every 'removeMin' operation in the output is applied to a non-empty heap.

postconditions.expression: all(len(heap) > 0 for line, heap in zip(output_lines, heap_state) if line.split()[0] == 'getMin')
postconditions.description: Every 'getMin' operation in the output is applied to a non-empty heap.
